issues.failure_explanation: The proofs of the forward spatial Hölder estimates for the diffusion and the scheme close a circular estimate only under a smallness condition on T, and the appendix proof has the same restriction. The proposition statement, however, makes the estimates for the whole interval [0,T] with a constant depending on T. No time-splitting or iteration argument extending the local-in-time estimates to arbitrary T is supplied.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add a time-splitting/semigroup iteration argument extending the local estimates from a small time horizon to arbitrary T, or restrict the proposition and the main theorem to a sufficiently small time horizon.
issues.overall_effect: The regularity estimates in prop-main-estimates are established only for sufficiently small T. The main theorem thm-main uses these estimates for all s,t in [0,T], so its proof for general T is unsupported.
issues.title: Regularity proofs assume a small time horizon but the proposition claims all T
issues.why_classification: The argument is valid locally but proves less than stated; extending to general T requires a contained but nontrivial localization/iteration argument, with no loss of the main rate.

issues.failure_explanation: Every drift contribution in the proof of the forward time Hölder estimate carries the factor (1+t^{-β/α}) or t^{-β/α}, while the final gathering claims the stronger factor t^{-γ/α}. Since β<γ, t^{-β/α} is larger than t^{-γ/α} for small t, so the proof establishes a materially weaker time singularity than the proposition states.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Either prove the stronger time factor using the spatial γ-regularity obtained in the appendix, or weaken the proposition's time factor from (t-s)^{-γ/α} to (1+t^{-β/α}), which still suffices for the proof of thm-main.
issues.overall_effect: The stated forward time regularity holder-time-gamma is not proved. The main theorem's rate survives with the weaker t^{-β/α} factor, so thm-main is not invalidated, but the proposition's advertised γ/α time regularity is unsupported.
issues.title: Proof of forward time regularity proves a weaker time factor than stated
issues.why_classification: The proof is valid but establishes a weaker conclusion than stated; the repair is a limited weakening or a contained bootstrap argument, and the main theorem's rate is preserved.

issues.title: Delta_2 integral is not O(1); it is of order t^{-β/α}
issues.why_classification: A short local correction of the integral evaluation preserves the theorem and its advertised rate.

issues.failure_explanation: The second term has exponent 1-(γ+2)/α = -(β+1)/α. Its integral over s is of order t^{(α-β-1)/α} for small h, which for t>1 can exceed t^{-β/α}. Thus the claim that the whole integral is ≲ t^{1-(γ+1)/α}=t^{-β/α} is not justified.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Bound the second-term integral by a T-dependent constant instead of by t^{-β/α}; the final theorem statement is unchanged.

issues.title: Delta_41 second-term integral is bounded by a T-dependent constant, not necessarily t^{-β/α}

issues.failure_explanation: No discrete Grönwall-Volterra lemma is stated or verified. For the inhomogeneous term a(t)=h^{γ/α}(1+t^{-β/α}), the standard Volterra resolvent gives an additional term of order h^{γ/α} t^{(α-β-1)/α}, which is not bounded by the claimed expression when α-β-1>0 and t is large. Thus the displayed inequality does not imply f(t) ≲ h^{γ/α}(1+t^{-β/α}) by the standard argument.
